scope.governance: Issue 0 bootstrap is a supporting governance scope; it must not replace the product scope.
scope.product: Issue 491 installed supervised configuration and launcher qualification.
scope.release_boundary: Current repository contracts, Issue 491 artifacts, applicable tests/builds/E2E, and live GitHub reconciliation. Live Issue #493 release publication is a separate follow-on control-plane scope and is explicitly not claimed by this run.

requirements.requirement: Implement and qualify deterministic gates G10 through G100 in the required order.
Use a deterministic candidate-content fingerprint independent of staging and commit state.
G40 protects pre-existing user work, scope, protected paths, deletions, dependencies, generated artifacts, and secrets.
G35 is based on an executable visible headed Playwright probe and is recoverable when the first browser surface fails.
G70 is read-only after validation and G75/G80/G85 prove tested-content-to-commit equivalence.
Finalizer and blocker admission reject recoverable technical failures as terminal outcomes.
Installed launcher exposes configure supervised, doctor --supervised, and profile-aware start/stop/status using the versioned supervised contract.
Configuration and secret storage enforce permissions, safe paths, input validation, redaction, and generated local secrets.
Default start remains safe Quickstart; supervised commands use the existing advanced Compose profile, real adapters, explicit repository coordinates, and merge kill switch.
Supervised doctor is read-only and validates the installed contract, Docker/host tools, safe flags, and readiness compatibility without mutation.
Installed user path needs no clone, internal environment variables, Compose knowledge, or manual configuration edits.
Missing or invalid token, repository, OpenCode, SpecKit, provider, and model produce actionable blocked results without secret disclosure.
Demo behavior remains unchanged and isolated from supervised state and volumes; no second runtime/readiness engine is introduced.
Tests cover parser, permissions, path safety, secret redaction, profile isolation, and launcher delegation; docs and architecture map are current.
Inventory and pass all applicable local format, lint, typecheck, unit, contract, integration, migration, build, security/policy, and package suites.
Pass applicable product E2E, route smoke, runtime/startup, and critical user journey checks before final content seal.
test: G65 npm run test:e2e and product smoke evidence

requirements.requirement: Compact AGENTS.md to a navigator while preserving unique valid rules in canonical policy locations.
Reconcile live repository, Issue #491, PRs, reviews, checks, and release state through the visible Playwright GitHub control plane.
Reconcile the open release-qualification follow-on and record its boundary without claiming release PR landing, tag publication, or independent public-install acceptance in the Issue-491 run.
requirements.reason: Issue #493 and release publication are a separate follow-on scope; this run records the boundary and does not claim release landing or public-install acceptance.

requirements.requirement: Existing Repository and Blueprint are the canonical validated project-entry contracts.
Positron remains the lifecycle authority; workers and adapters cannot self-approve, bypass gates, or merge without operator authorization.
Credentials cross the application only by reference and secret values do not persist in Git, databases, evidence, logs, screenshots, telemetry, or PR comments.
test: secret redaction and installer security suites

requirements.requirement: Requested, selected, and executed provider/model identities remain separate evidence fields.
Keep, rework, externalize, drop, and historical subsystem decisions are reconciled with their documented validation surfaces.
Constitutional obligations for durable evidence, no silent failure, resume-by-state, GitHub traceability, and human override remain enforced.
The installed release contains the supervised launcher required for configure, doctor, and lifecycle commands.
Supervised safety flags fail closed under configuration tampering and token values are single-line protected secrets.
Supervised doctor validates the installed operator-readiness contract in addition to host, tool, and repository prerequisites.
Missing or malformed supervised configuration fields produce structured actionable diagnostics instead of shell errors.
The documented route-smoke suite is executed separately and is not hidden by optional fixture skips.
Record the final GitHub repository, issue/PR, review, check, diff, risk, and release-boundary readback through the approved visible browser control plane.
Complete an independent post-Green multi-agent audit across matrix, gates, code, tests, clean state, E2E, architecture, security, and GitHub reality with no unresolved critical or major findings.
